def stat(input_str):
    if not input_str.strip():
        return ""

    def time_to_seconds(time_str):
        h, m, s = time_str.split('|')
        return int(h) * 3600 + int(m) * 60 + int(s)

    def seconds_to_time(seconds):
        hh = f"{seconds // 3600:02d}"
        mm = f"{(seconds % 3600) // 60:02d}"
        ss = f"{seconds % 60:02d}"
        return f"{hh}|{mm}|{ss}"

    times = [part.strip() for part in input_str.split(',') if part.strip()]
    seconds_list = [time_to_seconds(time) for time in times]

    range_seconds = max(seconds_list) - min(seconds_list)
    range_time = seconds_to_time(range_seconds)

    average_seconds = sum(seconds_list) // len(seconds_list)
    average_time = seconds_to_time(average_seconds)

    sorted_seconds = sorted(seconds_list)
    n = len(sorted_seconds)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        median_seconds = sorted_seconds[n // 2]
    else:
        median_seconds = (sorted_seconds[n // 2 - 1] + sorted_seconds[n // 2]) // 2
    median_time = seconds_to_time(median_seconds)

    return f"Range: {range_time} Average: {average_time} Median: {median_time}"
